design_laws: The authenticated Compact coordinate context retains complete ordered root shards; 30 named events at physical slots 12..41 include empty callbacks and both headers in each bucket StructurePrefix.
Captured slices use cumulative path-relative intervals, while saved pairs stay in original whole-data.bin compressed/decompressed coordinates. Production does not rebase them.

Private CompactStaticJsonAdvancedPreparedMark construction is source-only: ordinary value-free streams and the raw shared holder derive internally from the same completed framer, physical context, prefix, grid, legal role schedule and identical request budget.

ADVANCED_CHUNKED preparation authenticates the complete selected-column window on every request, including EOF/empty. Holders are request-local; implicit calls get fresh holders, explicit budgets stay cumulative. MAP stream-only caching remains unchanged.
Only selected shared values decode. The temporary logical stream view is non-mutating and isolated inside the prepared-mark owner; no getter exposes raw streams or the holder.
Ordinary Object/Dynamic full-prefix statistics remain intact. Shared Dynamic uses its own stats-free context.

Workspace observations count actual retained row/entry/path/value owners before ephemeral copying, preparation owners before metadata publication, and the captured-slice/context/shard retention chain with shared-context deduplication.

The owner census excludes complete transitive parsed-prefix/plan/type metadata, hash capacity and decoder-internal peaks; it is neither a predecode allocation ceiling nor RSS. Parts must be quiescent, and failed operations must be discarded.
